Reputable Media · 2026-10-08

Financial institutions must remain accountable for use of third-party AI tools: MAS

Sarah Koh's Straits Times report, republished by Singapore Law Watch, explains MAS's third-party AI expectations, including financial institutions' retained accountability, risk-appropriate transparency and testing, contingency arrangements and proportionate treatment of lower-materiality uses. It is secondary reporting and adds communication context; the official MAS Guidelines remain the evidential authority for the supervisory expectations.

Relationship: Coverage Of MAS AI Risk Management Guidelines — operative document verified.

Contribution: contextual analysis.
